title: F1 teams rejected fix for a big 2026 driver complaint
paragraphs: Formula 1 teams have rejected a rule change proposal that would have allowed Pirelli to address drivers' complaints and bring tyre pressures down. One frequent complaint aired by drivers this year is that the minimum tyre pressures mandated by Pirelli for the 2026 cars are too high. title: Cadillac makes abrupt F1 team principal change
paragraphs: Formula 1's newest team Cadillac has suddenly announced a change of team principal, as Marcin Budkowski has replaced Graeme Lowdon. title: Our verdict on F1 2026's biggest disappointments so far
paragraphs: Who or what has been the biggest disappointment of Formula 1's 2026 season so far? That's what we asked our team; here's what they said... Edd Straw: It has to be Aston Martin-Honda, given it wasn't long ago that it was seen as a team with the potential to emerge as a race-winning force thanks to the overhaul of the regulations.

title: Why F1's top teams face a big $6million dilemma
paragraphs: There's a $6million dilemma facing the top four Formula 1 teams that could be crucial to deciding this year's title fight. The frontrunning teams know that the final championship outcome is going to rest on the development war. And as we're only 11 races into this regulation cycle, teams are still finding big chunks of laptime when adding the latest developments to their cars.

title: The key F1 mistake McLaren can't correct until 2027
paragraphs: McLaren has admitted it pitched the wheelbase for its 2026 Formula 1 car too short, which will limit the potential of its aerodynamic development until a longer car can be made for 2027.
